$comment: Weapon properties. See README → Property files for the format.

properties.label: +1 Weapon
properties.text: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

properties.label: +2 Weapon
properties.text: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

properties.label: +3 Weapon
properties.text: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

properties.label: Elemental ({element.label})
properties.name: {element.name}
properties.text: A creature hit by this weapon takes an extra [[/damage @die @element]] damage.

properties.label: Keen
properties.name: Keen
properties.text: Attacks with this weapon score a critical hit on a roll of @threshold or higher.

properties.label: Vicious
properties.name: Vicious
properties.text: When you score a critical hit with this weapon, the target takes an extra @bonus damage of the weapon's type.

properties.label: of Warning
properties.name: of Warning
properties.text: While this item is on your person, you have advantage on initiative rolls.

properties.label: of Thunder
properties.name: of Thunder
properties.text: This weapon has 3 charges and regains [[/r 1d3]] expended charges daily at dawn. As an action, you can expend 1 charge to release a thunderclap: each creature within 10 feet of you must make a [[/save con @dc]] saving throw, taking [[/damage @damage thunder]] damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
